title: UK government details Global Clean Power Alliance missions
excerpt: The alliance focuses on finance and supply chain barriers to accelerate the global transition to clean power.
bodyHtml:
The UK government announced on October 30, 2026, the operational framework for the Global Clean Power Alliance. The alliance consists of partners from the Global North and Global South working to advance electrification and strengthen energy security. The alliance focuses on two of the biggest barriers to progress, which are finance and supply chains.

The alliance operates through two missions. The Finance Mission, co-led by the UK and Brazil, assists emerging markets and developing economies in attracting private investment for clean energy projects. This mission focuses on three building blocks: people, connecting countries with the expertise and tools they need; plans, developing credible and investment-ready energy plans; and projects, creating pipelines of clean-energy projects that can attract private finance.

The Supply Chains Mission works to diversify clean power supply chains, address bottlenecks, and promote data transparency and a global circular economy. The UK government stated that it will provide updates on the progress of both missions on the GOV.UK website.
